acceptance: mark to market net40>0 and PF/DD/long-tail healthy, full risk and causal fill witness; never auto promote
delayed_entry_negative_control: fixed 1 additional hourly bar of latency and same original exits; no tuning
entry_rule: TA-Lib seeded Wilder RSI14(close)<30 AND close< BollLower20_typical_price_2STD
exit_rule: TA-Lib seeded Wilder RSI14(close)>70; signal exit theoretical next bar open
last_candle: exclude incomplete most recent 08:00-09:00Z candle from Oct25 08:01:20Z archived fetch
mark_to_market: account starts 12 spot-equivalent units, open unrealized included at each completed hourly close; final right-censored open is unrealized, NOT omitted
order_model: theoretical next hourly open for signal; stop-first if low<=25pct stop; ROI10pct high, fill at target except adverse open; gap stop worse at OPEN; never historic real received_at assertion
original_strategy: BbandRsi 1h, author Gert Wohlgemuth converted Mynt
risk_ownership: one spot-equivalent long slot per symbol, fixed 1 unit price-notional, no compounding, no cross-symbol risk netting
rsi_calculation: TA-Lib Wilder initial 14 gain/loss SMA then recursive alpha=1/14
source_timestamp_limitation: received_at per original historical candle not verified, all backtest theoretical
stop_danger: original -25pct hard price stop not approved for 10x/15x/20x BingX leveraged futures
